# FinBERT Explainability Project

- Use Python 3.11 and PyTorch.
- Use Hugging Face Transformers, Datasets, and Captum.
- Write modular, maintainable, reproducible code.
- Use configuration files instead of hardcoded parameters.
- Use fixed random seeds and save experiment settings.
- Prevent train/validation/test data leakage.
- Never tune hyperparameters using test data.
- Implement unit tests for important functions.
- Support CPU and CUDA where possible.
- Save all metrics as JSON or CSV.
- Save all plots to results/figures.
- Never fabricate experimental results.
- Never claim attention is or is not faithful without evidence.
- Run relevant tests after changing code.
- Explain errors and report unresolved issues.
- Do not start expensive training without confirmation.
